title: Access detailed information (including token prices, tvl, volumes, fees and more
description: Access detailed information (including token prices, tvl, volumes, fees and more) about specific liquidity pools across multiple chains (Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum). Exchanges supported on Ethereum include Uniswap V2 / V4, Pancake V2 and Sushiswap V2 / V3. Exchanges supported on Arbitrum include Uniswap V4, Sushiswap V2 / V3 and Camelot V3. Exchanges supported on Base include Uniswap V2 / V3 / V4 and Sushiswap V3.
